TREE-01.where: tools/gui/ext/models/sub/tree.client.js:61 select (D.select({bone})), drawVol (D.select({volume})), D.on select keeps the tree in step; tools/lib/model/edit/tree.js:713 tree.list
TREE-01.test: tree.test.js: ok 5 click selects through D.select; model-edit-tree.test.js: edit-tree: tree.list
TREE-01.note: Bones and their volumes are rows; obstacles and areas are listed under the tree as plain rows (their editing is on the volumes tab). A pick made in another part (D.select) moves the tree pick too.

TREE-02.where: sub/tree.client.js pushHidden, drawBone, drawVol show boxes; sub/doc.client.js setHidden; sub/viewer.client.js hidBone, hidVol
TREE-02.note: Each bone and volume row has a show box, display only and never saved, as in SOEdit. A hidden bone hides its branch in the 3D view (meshes, bones, volumes); a hidden volume hides that volume. Opening another model shows everything again.

TREE-03.where: tools/gui/ext/models/sub/tree.client.js:187 keydown (Enter, F2), drawBone dblclick, fill (the bone form beside the tree)
TREE-03.test: tree.test.js: ok 6 rename from the form (Enter)
TREE-03.note: The bone form is always shown next to the tree, so Enter or double click moves the focus into it instead of opening a dialog. A volume row picks the volume for the volumes tab.

TREE-04.where: tools/gui/ext/models/sub/tree.client.js:78 ACTS, openMenu, off (greys what cannot apply)
TREE-04.test: tree.test.js: ok 7 the menu lists every action and turns off what cannot apply
TREE-04.note: Bone menu (right click, the Actions button or the ContextMenu key) with every bone action, greyed by the pick like SOEdit. Volume rows in the tree have no menu of their own: a double click opens the volume in the Volumes tab, where its actions are buttons. Missing: a right-click menu on volume rows and the Volume top menu.

TREE-05.note: Picks the first bone whose name matches, any case, while typing; Enter moves the focus to the tree, as in SOEdit. Better than SOEdit: a whole name match first, then a name that starts so, then one that holds the text anywhere; the branch above it is opened.

TREE-06.where: tools/gui/ext/models/sub/tree.client.js:119 branchOpen (menu Open all under it), the +/- button per row, Right arrow
TREE-06.note: Recursive like SOEdit from the menu; the row button and the arrow key open one level.

TREE-07.test: tree.test.js: ok 5 left on an open bone closes it

TREE-08.test: tree.test.js: ok 4 open all: every bone in file order
TREE-08.note: Also Close all, which SOEdit does not have.

TREE-09.note: Show or Hide these bones, their volumes, or both: sets the show boxes of the whole branch, display only, and the 3D view follows.
